literally started flooding but halfway through the show but it was so worth it. amazing setlist with my 3 favorite DCFC songs: black sun, i will possess your heart, and transatlanticism. plus an “i will follow you into the dark” featuring a very well-timed rolling thunder right before the chorus. a barfight nearly broke out in front of us too. 10/10

also this night was 10x better because my girlfriend surprised me with floor tickets that very day, right after my job training. she’s the best ever, i love her.
